findings.required: Validate the record shape and require every necessary consistency check to be true; wrong or unavailable launcher/argv evidence must remain inventory_verified at most. Cover these exact controls while preserving missing-record degradation.

findings.problem: The delivered CLI accepts arbitrary JSON as main provenance after checking only source==='main-start-record'. The pure module makes the same tag-based distinction. This establishes caller-record consistency, not origin from the original main/D spawn or a current runtime binding; nonsensical pid/start/uid are accepted in the independent controls.
findings.evidence: CLI lines409-423 read the file and pass it directly; runtime-identity.ts line250 trusts the tag. G documentation correctly disclaims liveness, but wave36-status calls this trusted/current identity and verified identity available for main.
findings.required: Keep caller JSON explicitly caller-declared and do not promote it to trusted/current provenance. Main may supply its original trusted startup observation through an internal boundary and compare exact canonical entry/root/config and verified inventory. Do not add global process discovery; absent trusted facts must remain unknown/null.
